name: Mercenary Spinning Gladius
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Spinning Gladius (players/gladiator/mercenary/gladius_merc.sval, 18 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): 3 gladii, no fan (1, fanned by Strength in Numbers); mana 50 (42). Its own mana 50 (42), cooldown 4 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Throws three gladii straight ahead; each spins in place for 3 s on impact, 128 magical per second.
